title: Death Curse Traps the Holy Body
summary: Wang Yangzhan, master of the Yin-Yang Sect, knows his foundation was wrecked when Ye Fan turned the Jiuli Painting on him and that little of his life is left. He makes a pact with Wang Teng: Ye Fan's life in exchange for Wang Teng's support for the sect. Two months later Ye Fan shares the Illusion-grade Divine Marrow with his friends, who scatter home, and goes with Ji Ziyue to the Qishi Academy. Qi Huoshui ('Qi Xiaoniu') attacks him there, and her brother Qi Lin, the Southern Demon, calls her off. Qi Lin talks with Ye Fan privately. He knows, through the Demon Emperor Palace's Eye of Heaven and Earth, that Ye Fan's group came from another world, and he promises to spare Ye Fan once if they ever meet on the road to becoming emperor. Wang Yangzhan then ambushes Ye Fan and dies casting the Yin-Yang Death Curse, which has no known cure, into him. A Qishi elder gives Ye Fan one day and night to live. Ji Ziyue pours in her Origin Spirit Body power and then reaches for the soul-bound ring from the Bronze Immortal Palace to save him.
